description: Download Playwright's Chromium (about 200 MB), the browser that draws the PDF. Only needed when doctor_markdown_pdf reports no browser (no Chrome or Edge on this computer). Ask the user before calling it. Returns status "installing" if the download is still running; call doctor_markdown_pdf a minute later to check.

force.description: Download even when a working browser is already found. Default: false.

name: install_browser_markdown_pdf
title: Install browser for Markdown PDF
